summary: In this excerpt from a novel, Anda and Lucy, two players in a fantasy MMO, accept a paid mission from the Clan to go kill some guys at a cottage on the far continent of Dandelionwine. Anda, a member of the Fahrenheits, learns from Lucy that Clan executives earn rent and sometimes riches from missions. On the tedious journey they fight off two groups of brigands, one of them a band of weak novice players, and then approach the guarded cottage, where sentries spot them and raise a warning spell.
one_line: Anda and Lucy, members of the Fahrenheits in a fantasy MMO, take a paid assassination mission to a guarded cottage on Dandelionwine.
key_facts: Lucy tells Anda that all the executives in the Clan pay the rent by doing missions for money.
Anda had assumed stories about gamers who could not tell reality from fantasy were just stories.
The mission sends Anda and Lucy far from Fahrenheit Island to a cottage on the far side of the largest continent on the gameworld, called Dandelionwine.
Twice on the trail the pair are ambushed, something that had hardly happened to Anda since she joined the Fahrenheits.
Lucy spotted the first group of brigands and killed four of the six with her bow before they closed for hand-to-hand combat.
Anda's sword is described as gigantic and fast, and she wins her fight against the attacking player.
The first group's bodies yield some gold and a couple of scrolls, which the pair consider nothing to write home about.
The second group of brigands numbers 20 players who are total noobs and fight like statues.
One brigand begs for his life with the message 'please sorry u cn have my gold sorry!!!11!' before Anda runs him through.
Anda sends the begging brigand to the respawn gate and calls Lucy's remark that she is nasty a fitting description of herself as a Fahrenheit.
The brigands on the road were punters, but the cottage target is guarded by a more sophisticated sort of player.
Sentries on a hilltop spot the pair long before they see the cottage and send a warning spell toward it like a puff of smoke.
